name: Craft Stimulant (Item Creation)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Caster or manifester level 5th.

Benefit(s): You can create stimulants*. Crafting a stimulant takes 1 day for each 1,000 gp in its base price. To craft a stimulant, you must use up raw materials costing half of its base price.
